description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1769/16 of 03.08.2012, Nawagaththegama D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette notice is about the amendment of land area (from 0.124 to 0.121 Hectare) for a specific land allotment (Land No. 150) acquired for the Inginimitiya Reservoir Project under the Land Acquisition Act. It deals specifically with land acquisition and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registration, acquisition, and boundary/size modifications for a specific property.
